create_imagery_client: create an ImageryClient instance to connect to a camera vision job via FluxWorks RPC
start_capture: start a camera capture session with a custom run_id using ImageryClient start_capture method
stop_capture: stop the current camera capture session using ImageryClient stop_capture method
get_camera_images: get the latest camera images as a dictionary keyed by camera id using get_camera_images
convert_camera_frame_to_image_dict: convert a CameraFrame protobuf to a dictionary of image arrays using _convert_camera_frame_to_image_dict
